faq.a: JAY-23 is a prelaunch marketing agency. We run the MVA Framework — a 90-day audience-building program executed before product launch.
MVA (Minimum Viable Audience) is a 90-day prelaunch program that builds 1,000 true fans through content systems, community, email funnels, and direct-response paid campaigns on Meta and Google.
Founders launching DTC products, crowdfunding campaigns (Kickstarter, Indiegogo), and SaaS startups that need a validated audience before launch day.
English-market engagement starts at $1,500 per month. Polish-market engagement starts at 6,000 PLN per month (about 18,000 PLN for the full 90-day program).
46+ launched campaigns. Over $1.2M raised in prelaunch revenue across crowdfunding and DTC channels.
JAY23 LLC is registered in Wyoming, United States. The team operates remotely and serves clients worldwide, with native support for English and Polish markets.
JAY-23 was founded by Marek Cieśla. His professional profile is at https://www.linkedin.com/in/marekciesla/.
